purpose: Sixteenth-pass official and first-party verification for six existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator or booking routes, NHS records, Companies House records and official local-authority planning or licensing routes are promoted. Directory-only claims and inferred lease completion are not promoted.
method.current_status_policy: A live store page, booking route, recruitment advert, digital membership route or licence application can verify current operational identity or activity but does not by itself prove lease continuation, licence grant, legal completion or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
